scene: A deer standing side-on on a grass line: a slim body, long thin legs, a short tail, a long neck held high and wide branching antlers with many points on its head. No beard, no fence, no person.
must: wide branching antlers on a slim long-legged body.
avoid: short curved horns and a small beard (geit); a horse (not the card); a reindeer pulling a sledge (not the card); a cow (koe).
contrast: Pair with geit. The only difference is the thing: wide branching antlers here, short curved horns and a small beard there.
example_nl: In het bos zagen we een hert.
example_en: We saw a deer in the forest.
alt: Een slank dier met lange dunne poten en een groot vertakt gewei staat in het gras.

scene: A goat standing side-on on the same grass line: a stocky body, short legs, a short upright tail, two short horns curving backwards, upright ears and a small tuft of beard under its chin. No antlers, no rope, no person.
must: short backward-curving horns and a small beard under the chin.
avoid: wide branching antlers (hert); a sheep with a woolly coat (schaap); a cow (koe); a ram with spiral horns (not the card).
contrast: Pair with hert. The only difference is the thing: short curved horns and a small beard here, wide branching antlers there.
example_nl: De geit eet gras in de wei.
example_en: The goat eats grass in the meadow.
alt: Een stevig dier met korte naar achteren gebogen hoorntjes en een plukje haar onder de kin staat in het gras.

scene: A stork standing side-on in shallow water: a large body, long thin legs, a straight neck held upright, a long straight thick bill and a smooth head with no plume. Wings folded. No baby, no nest, no fish.
must: a straight upright neck and a long straight thick bill.
avoid: a thin neck in a double curve with a head plume (reiger); a crane bird (not the card); a flamingo (not the card); a stork carrying a baby (not the card).
contrast: Pair with reiger. The only difference is the thing: a straight neck and a thick bill here, a thin curved neck and a head plume there.
example_nl: Op het dak staat een ooievaar.
example_en: A stork is standing on the roof.
alt: Een grote vogel met lange poten, een rechte hals en een lange dikke rechte snavel staat in ondiep water.

scene: A heron standing side-on in the same shallow water: a slim body, long thin legs, a thin neck folded in a double curve, a long sharp dagger bill and a thin plume trailing from the back of the head. No fish in the bill, no nest.
must: a thin neck folded in a double curve and a plume on the head.
avoid: a straight neck and a thick bill (ooievaar); a swan (zwaan); a flamingo (not the card); a duck (eend).
contrast: Pair with ooievaar. The only difference is the thing: a thin curved neck and a head plume here, a straight neck and a thick bill there.
example_nl: De reiger wacht stil bij de sloot.
example_en: The heron waits quietly by the ditch.
alt: Een slanke vogel met een dunne hals in een dubbele bocht en een lange pluim achter op de kop staat in het water.

scene: An owl sitting upright on a bare branch, seen from the front: a round body, a flat round face disc, two big round eyes facing forward, a small hooked beak between them, two ear tufts and a short tail. No cage, no moon.
must: a flat round face with two big forward-facing eyes.
avoid: a big hooked bill and a long tail (papegaai); a cat (kat); a pigeon (not the card); a cartoon owl with a hat (not the card).
contrast: Pair with papegaai. The only difference is the thing: a flat round face with big forward eyes here, a big hooked bill and a long tail there.
example_nl: De uil jaagt in het donker.
example_en: The owl hunts in the dark.
alt: Een ronde vogel met een plat rond gezicht en twee grote ogen recht vooruit zit op een tak.

scene: A parrot sitting upright on the same bare branch, seen from the front: a slim body, a large curved hooked bill, small eyes on the sides of the head, feet gripping with two toes in front and two behind, and a long pointed tail hanging down. No cage, no pattern.
must: a big curved hooked bill and a long pointed tail.
avoid: a flat round face with big forward eyes (uil); a toucan (not the card); a pigeon (not the card); a parrot in a cage (kooi).
contrast: Pair with uil. The only difference is the thing: a big hooked bill and a long tail here, a flat round face with big forward eyes there.
example_nl: Onze papegaai kan hallo zeggen.
example_en: Our parrot can say hello.
alt: Een slanke vogel met een grote kromme snavel en een lange puntige staart zit op een tak.

scene: A snail crawling side-on along a flat leaf: a soft smooth foot stretched out, a round spiral shell on its back, and two long feelers with eye dots on top and two short ones below. A thin trail line behind. No legs.
must: a spiral shell on the back of a soft body with feelers.
avoid: a segmented body with many short legs (rups); a slug without a shell (not the card); a worm (not the card); an empty shell on a beach (not the card).
contrast: Pair with rups. The only difference is the thing: a soft body with a spiral shell here, a segmented body with many short legs there.
example_nl: Na de regen zie je veel slakken.
example_en: After the rain you see lots of snails.
alt: Een zacht dier met een rond gedraaid huisje op de rug en twee lange voelsprieten kruipt over een blad.

scene: A caterpillar crawling side-on along the same flat leaf: a long body made of round segments in a row, a small round head, many short stubby legs underneath and a few short hairs. No shell, no wings.
must: a long body of round segments with many short legs.
avoid: a spiral shell on the back (slak); a worm with no legs (not the card); a centipede with long legs (not the card); a butterfly (vlinder).
contrast: Pair with slak. The only difference is the thing: a segmented body with many short legs here, a soft body with a spiral shell there.
example_nl: De rups eet gaten in de blaadjes.
example_en: The caterpillar eats holes in the leaves.
alt: Een lang lijfje van ronde ringen achter elkaar met veel korte pootjes kruipt over een blad.

scene: A crocodile lying side-on on a ground line: a long heavy body, short bent legs, a long flat snout with a row of teeth showing along the jaw, eye bumps on top of the head and rows of raised ridges along the back and tail.
must: a long toothed snout and raised ridges along the back.
avoid: a small head on a slender smooth body (hagedis); a dinosaur on two legs (not the card); a snake (slang-dier); a frog (not the card).
contrast: Pair with hagedis. The only difference is the thing: a long toothed snout and a ridged back here, a small head on a slender smooth body there.
example_nl: De krokodil ligt stil in de zon.
example_en: The crocodile lies still in the sun.
alt: Een lang zwaar dier met korte poten, een lange platte bek vol tanden en ribbels op de rug ligt op de grond.

scene: A lizard lying side-on on the same ground line: a slender smooth body, a small pointed head, four thin legs with spread toes, and a long thin tapering tail. Tiny scale dots, no ridges, no teeth showing.
must: a small pointed head on a slender body with a long thin tail.
avoid: a long toothed snout and a ridged back (krokodil); a salamander (not the card); a snake (slang-dier); a mouse (muis).
contrast: Pair with krokodil. The only difference is the thing: a small head on a slender smooth body here, a long toothed snout and a ridged back there.
example_nl: Er zit een hagedis op de muur.
example_en: There is a lizard on the wall.
alt: Een slank glad diertje met een klein puntig kopje, dunne pootjes en een lange dunne staart ligt op de grond.

scene: A crab seen from above on a sandy line: a wide round flat shell, two claws held in front, four thin jointed legs on each side spreading sideways, and two small eyes on stalks. No tail, no plate.
must: a wide round shell with legs spreading out to both sides.
avoid: a long body with a fan tail (kreeft); a spider (not the card); a crab on a plate (not the card); an empty shell (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kreeft. The only difference is the thing: a wide round shell with sideways legs here, a long body with a fan tail there.

example_en: We find a crab on the beach.
alt: Een breed rond plat schild met twee scharen voorop en dunne poten opzij ligt op het zand.

scene: A lobster seen from above on the same sandy line: a long body in segments, two big heavy claws in front, long thin feelers, four thin legs on each side and a wide fan-shaped tail at the back. No plate, no pot.
must: a long segmented body with two big claws and a fan tail.
avoid: a wide round shell with sideways legs (krab); a shrimp (not the card); a scorpion (not the card); a lobster on a plate (not the card).
contrast: Pair with krab. The only difference is the thing: a long body with a fan tail here, a wide round shell with sideways legs there.
example_nl: In het restaurant eten ze kreeft.
example_en: In the restaurant they eat lobster.
alt: Een lang geleed lijf met twee grote zware scharen voorop en een waaiervormige staart ligt op het zand.

scene: An otter sitting side-on on a riverbank: a long slim body, a flat head with small round ears, long whiskers, short legs with webbed feet and a long thick tail that tapers to a point. No fish, no dam.
must: a long slim body with a long tail tapering to a point.
avoid: a broad flat paddle tail and big front teeth (bever); a cat (kat); a seal (not the card); a rat (not the card).
contrast: Pair with bever. The only difference is the thing: a long tapering tail here, a broad flat paddle tail and big front teeth there.

example_en: The otter swims fast through the water.
alt: Een lang slank harig dier met snorharen en een dikke staart die spits toeloopt zit aan de oever.

scene: A beaver sitting side-on on the same riverbank: a round heavy body, a blunt head with two big front teeth, small ears, short legs and a broad flat paddle tail with a criss-cross scale pattern lying on the ground. No dam, no tree.
must: a broad flat paddle tail and two big front teeth.
avoid: a long tail tapering to a point (otter); a guinea pig (not the card); a rat (not the card); a hedgehog (egel).
contrast: Pair with otter. The only difference is the thing: a broad flat paddle tail and big front teeth here, a long tapering tail there.
example_nl: De bever bouwt een dam in de rivier.
example_en: The beaver builds a dam in the river.
alt: Een rond zwaar harig dier met twee grote voortanden en een brede platte staart zit aan de oever.

scene: A closed mussel lying flat on a table line, seen from above: a long smooth oval shell, narrow and pointed at one end and rounded at the other, with fine curved growth lines. No pearl, no plate.
must: a long smooth oval shell pointed at one end.
avoid: a rough round wavy shell (oester); a snail shell (slak); a ribbed scallop shell (not the card); a pot of mussels (not the card).
contrast: Pair with oester. The only difference is the thing: a long smooth oval shell here, a rough round wavy shell there.
example_nl: Wij eten mosselen met friet.
example_en: We eat mussels with chips.
alt: Een gesloten lang glad ovaal schelpdier, aan één kant spits, ligt op tafel.

scene: A closed oyster lying flat on the same table line, seen from above: a rough rounded shell with thick wavy layered edges and irregular bumps. No pearl, no ice, no lemon.
must: a rough rounded shell with thick wavy layered edges.
avoid: a long smooth oval shell (mossel); a stone (not the card); a ribbed scallop shell (not the card); an open shell with a pearl (not the card).
contrast: Pair with mossel. The only difference is the thing: a rough round wavy shell here, a long smooth oval shell there.
example_nl: Een oester kan een parel maken.
example_en: An oyster can make a pearl.
alt: Een gesloten ruw rond schelpdier met dikke golvende randen in lagen ligt op tafel.

scene: A jellyfish floating in water: a round see-through bell shown by a few curved shine strokes, a frilly edge, and many long thin wavy threads hanging below. No eyes, no arms with suckers.
must: a round see-through bell with long thin threads hanging below.
avoid: a long body with eyes and arms (inktvis); a plastic bag (not the card); an umbrella (not the card); an octopus (not the card).
contrast: Pair with inktvis. The only difference is the thing: a see-through bell with thin threads here, a long body with eyes and arms there.
example_nl: Pas op voor de kwallen in zee.
example_en: Watch out for the jellyfish in the sea.
alt: Een doorzichtige ronde klok met heel veel lange dunne draden eronder drijft in het water.

scene: A squid floating in the same water: a long pointed body with two small fins at the top, two big eyes, and eight short arms and two longer arms with small sucker dots trailing below. No ink cloud, no bell.
must: a long pointed body with two big eyes and arms with suckers.
avoid: a round see-through bell with thin threads (kwal); an octopus with a round head (not the card); a fish (vis); a shrimp (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kwal. The only difference is the thing: a long body with eyes and arms here, a see-through bell with thin threads there.
example_nl: In Spanje eten ze vaak inktvis.
example_en: In Spain they often eat squid.
alt: Een lang puntig zeedier met twee grote ogen en armen met zuignapjes zwemt in het water.

scene: A grasshopper sitting side-on on a bare stem: a long narrow body, a blunt head with a big eye, very short thick antennae, wings folded along the back and big folded back legs ready to jump.
must: very short thick antennae on a narrow body with big back legs.
avoid: very long thin antennae reaching past the body (krekel); a praying mantis (not the card); a swarm of insects (not the card); a fly (not the card).
contrast: Pair with krekel. The only difference is the thing: very short thick antennae here, very long thin antennae there.
example_nl: De sprinkhaan springt hoog in het gras.
example_en: The grasshopper jumps high in the grass.
alt: Een lang smal insect met heel korte dikke sprieten en grote achterpoten zit op een stengel.

scene: A cricket sitting side-on on the same bare stem: a slightly stockier body, a round head, very long thin antennae reaching back past the end of the body, wings folded flat and big folded back legs.
must: very long thin antennae reaching back past the body.
avoid: very short thick antennae (sprinkhaan); a beetle (not the card); a cockroach (not the card); an ant (not the card).
contrast: Pair with sprinkhaan. The only difference is the thing: very long thin antennae here, very short thick antennae there.
example_nl: Ik hoor een krekel in de tuin.
example_en: I hear a cricket in the garden.
alt: Een gedrongen insect met heel lange dunne sprieten die tot voorbij het lijf reiken zit op een stengel.

scene: A squirrel sitting upright side-on on a grass line: a small slim body, tufted ears, small front paws held together at the chest and a big bushy tail curled up along its back and over its head. No nut, no tree, no spines.
must: a big bushy tail curled up along the back.
avoid: a round body covered in spines (egel); a rat (not the card); a cat (kat); a rabbit (konijn).
contrast: Pair with egel. The only difference is the thing: a big bushy tail here, a round body covered in spines there.
example_nl: De eekhoorn verstopt nootjes in de grond.
example_en: The squirrel hides nuts in the ground.
alt: Een klein slank dier met pluimpjes aan de oren en een grote pluizige staart over de rug zit rechtop in het gras.

scene: A hedgehog walking side-on on the same grass line: a round low body covered on top in many short spines drawn as short strokes, a pointed snout with a round nose, small eyes and short legs. No tail visible, no apple.
must: a round low body covered in short spines with a pointed snout.
avoid: a big bushy tail (eekhoorn); a porcupine with long quills (not the card); a mole (not the card); a pine cone (not the card).
contrast: Pair with eekhoorn. The only difference is the thing: a round body covered in spines here, a big bushy tail there.
example_nl: 's Avonds loopt er een egel door de tuin.
example_en: In the evening a hedgehog walks through the garden.
alt: Een rond laag diertje vol korte stekels met een spitse snuit loopt door het gras.

scene: A telescope seen side-on: one long single tube, wider at the front end and narrow at the eyepiece, mounted at an angle on a small three-legged stand on the table line. No stars, no person.
must: one long single tube on a three-legged stand.
avoid: two short tubes side by side (verrekijker); a camera (not the card); a cannon (not the card); a microscope (not the card).
contrast: Pair with verrekijker. The only difference is the thing: one long tube on a stand here, two short tubes side by side there.

example_en: Through the telescope you see the moon.
alt: Eén lange buis, voor breder dan achter, staat schuin op een kleine driepoot op tafel.

scene: A pair of binoculars lying on the same table line, seen side-on: two short tubes joined side by side by a hinge in the middle, with two eyepieces at one end and two wider lenses at the other, and a neck strap. No stand.
must: two short tubes joined side by side with a strap.
avoid: one long tube on a stand (telescoop); a pair of glasses (not the card); a camera (not the card); two cups (not the card).
contrast: Pair with telescoop. The only difference is the thing: two short tubes side by side here, one long tube on a stand there.
example_nl: Neem je verrekijker mee naar het strand.
example_en: Take your binoculars to the beach.
alt: Twee korte buizen naast elkaar, in het midden verbonden, met een riempje, liggen op tafel.

scene: A tomato lying on a cutting board, seen side-on: a round smooth slightly flattened ball with a shine stroke and, on top, a small star of pointed leaves around a short stalk. No slice, no knife.
must: a round smooth ball with a small star of leaves on top.
avoid: a blocky lobed body with a thick stalk (paprika); an apple with a stalk and one leaf (appel); a cherry (kers); an orange (sinaasappel).
contrast: Pair with paprika. The only difference is the thing: a round smooth ball here, a blocky lobed body there.
example_nl: Ik snijd een tomaat voor de salade.
example_en: I cut a tomato for the salad.
alt: Een ronde gladde bol met een klein sterretje van blaadjes bovenop ligt op een plankje.

scene: A bell pepper lying on the same cutting board, seen side-on: a blocky body with three or four rounded lobes at the bottom, deep folds down the sides, a shine stroke and a thick curved stalk on top. No slice, no knife.
must: a blocky body with lobes at the bottom and a thick stalk.
avoid: a round smooth ball with a star of leaves (tomaat); a chilli pepper (not the card); an apple (appel); a pumpkin (pompoen).
contrast: Pair with tomaat. The only difference is the thing: a blocky lobed body here, a round smooth ball there.
example_nl: Ze vult de paprika met rijst.
example_en: She fills the pepper with rice.
alt: Een hoekige vrucht met bobbels onderaan, diepe plooien en een dikke gebogen steel ligt op een plankje.

scene: A lemon lying whole on a table line beside one cut half of it, seen side-on: an oval fruit with a small pointed tip at each end, skin dotted with tiny pores, and the cut half showing a wheel of segments. No leaf, no glass, no knife.
must: an oval fruit with a pointed tip at each end, beside its cut half.
avoid: a perfectly round fruit with a dimple (sinaasappel); a lime (not the card); an egg (ei-een); a lemon slice on a glass (not the card).
contrast: Pair with sinaasappel. The only difference is the thing: an oval fruit with pointed tips here, a perfectly round fruit there.

example_en: Put some lemon in the tea.
alt: Een ovale vrucht met aan beide kanten een puntje en een schil vol stipjes ligt op tafel, naast een doorgesneden helft met partjes.

scene: A sinaasappel lying whole on the same table line beside one cut half of it, seen side-on: a perfectly round citrus fruit with a small dimple on top, skin dotted with tiny pores, and the cut half showing a wheel of segments. No leaf, no knife.
must: a perfectly round fruit with a small dimple, beside its cut half.
avoid: an oval fruit with pointed tips (citroen); a round fruit with no cut half (not the card); a tomato (tomaat); a peach (not the card).
contrast: Pair with citroen. The only difference is the thing: a perfectly round fruit here, an oval fruit with pointed tips there.
example_nl: Ik pers een sinaasappel voor het ontbijt.
example_en: I squeeze an orange for breakfast.
alt: Een helemaal ronde vrucht met een kuiltje bovenop en een schil vol stipjes ligt op tafel, naast een doorgesneden helft met partjes.

scene: A small round biscuit lying flat on a plate, seen from above: a flat disc with a crimped wavy edge and a few small pricked holes in the middle. No icing, no bite taken, no cup.
must: a small flat round disc with a crimped edge.
avoid: a square with a grid of deep holes (wafel); a coin (not the card); a cracker (not the card); a pancake (not the card).
contrast: Pair with wafel. The only difference is the thing: a small round disc with a crimped edge here, a square with a grid of deep holes there.
example_nl: Bij de koffie krijg je een koekje.
example_en: You get a biscuit with your coffee.
alt: Een klein plat rond schijfje met een gekartelde rand en een paar gaatjes ligt op een bordje.

scene: A square waffle lying flat on the same plate, seen from above: a thick square with a raised grid of crossing ridges forming deep square holes, and slightly rounded corners. No cream, no fruit, no syrup.
must: a thick square with a grid of deep square holes.
avoid: a small round disc with a crimped edge (koekje); a cracker (not the card); a slice of toast (not the card); a chessboard (not the card).
contrast: Pair with koekje. The only difference is the thing: a square with a grid of deep holes here, a small round disc there.
example_nl: Op de markt eten we een warme wafel.
example_en: At the market we eat a warm waffle.
alt: Een dik vierkant met een raster van diepe vierkante vakjes ligt op een bordje.

scene: A cherry lying on a table line, seen side-on: a smooth round fruit with a shine stroke and a long thin stalk rising from a small dip on top. No leaf, no second cherry, no seeds on the skin.
must: a smooth round fruit on a long thin stalk.
avoid: a heart shape with seeds and a leafy cap (aardbei); a fruit of tiny bumps (framboos); a tomato (tomaat); a grape (not the card).
contrast: Pair with aardbei and framboos. The only difference is the thing: a smooth round fruit on a long stalk here, a seeded heart shape or a fruit of tiny bumps there.

alt: Een glad rond vruchtje met een lange dunne steel ligt op tafel.

scene: A strawberry lying on the same table line, seen side-on: a heart-shaped fruit, wide at the top and pointed at the bottom, dotted all over with tiny seeds, with a cap of small pointed leaves and a short stalk on top.
must: a heart-shaped fruit dotted with seeds under a leafy cap.
avoid: a smooth round fruit on a long stalk (kers); a fruit of tiny round bumps (framboos); a heart symbol (not the card); a pine cone (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kers and framboos. The only difference is the thing: a seeded heart shape here, a smooth round fruit on a stalk or a fruit of tiny bumps there.

example_en: I like eating strawberries with whipped cream.
alt: Een hartvormig vruchtje vol kleine zaadjes met een kroontje van blaadjes ligt op tafel.

scene: A raspberry lying on the same table line, seen side-on: a rounded cone made of many tiny round bumps packed together, with a small hollow at the wide end. No leaves, no stalk.
must: a rounded cone made of many tiny round bumps.
avoid: a smooth round fruit on a stalk (kers); a heart-shaped fruit with seeds (aardbei); a blackberry on a bramble (not the card); a bunch of grapes (not the card).
contrast: Pair with kers and aardbei. The only difference is the thing: a cone of tiny bumps here, a smooth round fruit on a stalk or a seeded heart shape there.
example_nl: De framboos groeit aan een struik.
example_en: The raspberry grows on a bush.
alt: Een bol kegeltje van heel veel kleine bolletjes tegen elkaar ligt op tafel.

scene: A pumpkin lying on a table line, seen side-on: a big round slightly flattened fruit with deep curved ribs running from top to bottom and a thick twisted woody stalk on top. No face carved in it, no candle.
must: deep curved ribs and a thick woody stalk on top.
avoid: a smooth skin with a net pattern (meloen); a carved lantern face (not the card); a ball (not the card); a tomato (tomaat).

alt: Een grote ronde vrucht met diepe ribbels van boven naar beneden en een dikke houten steel ligt op tafel.

scene: A melon lying on the same table line, seen side-on: a big round slightly oval fruit with a smooth skin covered in a fine net of raised lines, and only a small scar where the stalk was. No ribs, no slice.
must: a smooth oval fruit covered in a fine net pattern.
avoid: deep ribs and a woody stalk (pompoen); a striped watermelon (not the card); a ball (not the card); a coconut (not the card).
contrast: Pair with pompoen. The only difference is the thing: a smooth net-patterned skin here, deep ribs and a woody stalk there.
example_nl: Een stuk meloen is lekker fris.
example_en: A piece of melon is nice and fresh.
alt: Een grote ovale vrucht met een gladde schil vol fijne netlijntjes ligt op tafel.

scene: A peanut in its shell lying on a table line, seen from above: a long pod pinched in the middle like a waist, with a fine criss-cross net pattern on the shell. Closed, no loose nuts.

avoid: a round wrinkled shell (walnoot); a flat pointed oval (amandel); a bean pod (not the card); a cocoon (not the card).
contrast: Pair with walnoot and amandel. The only difference is the thing: a long pod with a waist here, a round wrinkled shell or a flat pointed oval there.

alt: Een langwerpig dopje met een insnoering in het midden en een fijn netpatroon ligt op tafel.

scene: A walnut in its shell lying on the same table line, seen from above: a round shell with deep twisting wrinkles and a raised seam around the middle. Closed, no cracked pieces.
must: a round shell with deep wrinkles and a seam around the middle.
avoid: a long pod with a waist (pinda); a flat pointed oval (amandel); a brain (not the card); a stone (not the card).
contrast: Pair with pinda and amandel. The only difference is the thing: a round wrinkled shell here, a long pod with a waist or a flat pointed oval there.

example_en: Lots of walnuts lie under the tree.
alt: Een ronde dop met diepe kronkelige rimpels en een naad rondom ligt op tafel.

scene: An almond lying on the same table line, seen from above: a flat oval nut, rounded at one end and pointed at the other, with small pits and fine lengthwise lines on its skin. No shell pieces.

avoid: a small instrument leaning against a chair leg (viool); a double bass taller than a person (not the card); a guitar (not the card); a harp (not the card).
contrast: Pair with viool. The only difference is the thing: a tall instrument standing beside the chair here, a small instrument against the chair leg there.
example_nl: Zij speelt cello in een orkest.
example_en: She plays the cello in an orchestra.
alt: Een groot gebogen instrument met vier snaren staat op een pin naast de stoel en komt boven de zitting uit.

scene: A trumpet lying on a table line, seen side-on: a small mouthpiece, a tube folded into one compact loop, three upright valve buttons in a row in the middle, and a flared bell at the front. No player, no music.
must: a compact folded tube with three upright valve buttons.
avoid: a long sliding tube (trombone); a horn with a round coiled tube (not the card); a saxophone (not the card); a snorkel (snorkel).
contrast: Pair with trombone. The only difference is the thing: three upright valve buttons here, a long sliding tube there.
example_nl: Hij speelt trompet in de fanfare.
example_en: He plays the trumpet in the brass band.
alt: Een kort gevouwen buis met drie rechtopstaande knopjes in het midden en een wijde opening voorop ligt op tafel.

scene: A trombone lying on the same table line, seen side-on: a small mouthpiece, a long straight bell section with a flared bell at the front, and a long sliding tube bent back in a narrow loop alongside it. No valve buttons, no player.
must: a long sliding tube in a narrow loop and no buttons.
avoid: three upright valve buttons (trompet); a tuba (not the card); a saxophone (not the card); a curtain rail (not the card).
contrast: Pair with trompet. The only difference is the thing: a long sliding tube here, three upright valve buttons there.
example_nl: De trombone klinkt laag en warm.
example_en: The trombone sounds low and warm.
alt: Een lange buis met een wijde opening en een lange schuif in een smalle lus ligt op tafel.

scene: A bare adult knee seen from the front, leg slightly bent, with a short open cut across the kneecap: a jagged line with small torn edges and a few short scratch strokes beside it. No plaster, no drops, no hand.
must: a short jagged open cut on the bare knee.
avoid: a plaster with a pad stuck over the knee (pleister); a scar (not the card); a bruise (not the card); a bandage wrapped round (not the card).
contrast: Pair with pleister. The only difference is the thing: an open cut on bare skin here, a plaster stuck over the knee there.
example_nl: De dokter maakt de wond schoon.
example_en: The doctor cleans the wound.
alt: Een blote knie met een korte gekartelde snee met rafelige randen.

scene: The same bare adult knee seen from the front, leg slightly bent, with a sticking plaster across the kneecap: a rectangular strip with rounded corners, a square pad in the middle and tiny air-hole dots on the ends. Nothing visible under it.
must: a rectangular strip with a pad in the middle stuck on the knee.
avoid: an open cut on bare skin (wond); a bandage wrapped round (not the card); a sports knee pad (not the card); a tattoo (not the card).
contrast: Pair with wond. The only difference is the thing: a plaster stuck over the knee here, an open cut on bare skin there.
example_nl: Ik plak een pleister op mijn knie.
example_en: I stick a plaster on my knee.
alt: Dezelfde blote knie met een rechthoekig strookje met afgeronde hoeken en een kussentje in het midden erop geplakt.

scene: One animal drawn as the koe card without its udder, standing side-on on a flat grass line under plain sky: a heavy body, short legs, short curved horns, a thick neck and a tufted tail. Empty grass on both sides, no fence, no person.
must: one single stocky horned animal with empty grass on both sides.
avoid: three animals in a row (rund-meer); a dairy cow with an udder (koe); a bull with a ring in its nose (not the card); a buffalo (not the card).
contrast: Pair with rund-meer. The only difference is the number: one animal here, three identical animals side by side there.
example_nl: Het rund eet gras in de wei.
example_en: The animal eats grass in the meadow.
alt: Eén stevig dier met korte hoorns en een dikke nek staat alleen in het gras.

scene: Three identical stocky beef animals standing side-on on one flat grass line under plain sky, evenly spaced with gaps of grass between them, each the koe card drawing without its udder, each the same size as the single animal.
must: three identical stocky horned animals separated by gaps.
avoid: one animal alone (rund-een); a herd of dairy cows (koe); two animals (not the card); a crowd of overlapping animals (not the card).
contrast: Pair with rund-een. The only difference is the number: three identical animals side by side here, one animal alone there.
example_nl: De boer heeft honderd runderen.
example_en: The farmer has a hundred cattle.
alt: Drie gelijke stevige dieren met korte hoorns staan naast elkaar met ruimte ertussen.
